defects_argued.quote: These aspects have not been considered while passing the impugned order, dated 16.06.2023, in which a sum of Rs.16,40,742/- has been demanded and at the same time a sum of Rs.1,82,988/- was appropriated.

Since the petitioner has not been heard while passing the final order and time was sought for by the petitioner’s Consultant, I am of the view that the case can be remitted back for the petitioner to participate in the proceedings.

outcome.quote: Accordingly, the impugned order, dated 16.06.2023 is set aside and the case shall be remitted back to the respondent.
